content.intro: This lesson covers Adding, Updating, and Removing Dependencies. It sits in Module 11, Modules, Crates, Packages, and Cargo, and builds toward a practical Rust mental model rather than memorizing a term in isolation.
content.why_it_matters: Adding, Updating, and Removing Dependencies matters when you work with type-safe program design. Understanding the rule helps you predict compiler or runtime behavior, document assumptions, and choose a safer implementation when inputs or system conditions change.
